def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    marker_colors = set(counts) - {fill, separator}
    marker_positions = [
        (r, c)
        for r in range(h)
        for c in range(w)
        if grid[r][c] in marker_colors
    ]
    if not marker_positions:
        return []

    rmin = min(r for r, c in marker_positions)
    rmax = max(r for r, c in marker_positions)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in marker_positions)
    cmax = max(c for r, c in marker_positions)

    rows = [r for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1)
            if all(grid[r][c] != fill for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(cmin, cmax + 1)
            if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
           for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]

    for r in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for c in range(len(cols) - 1):
            block = [nodes[r][c], nodes[r][c + 1],
                     nodes[r + 1][c], nodes[r + 1][c + 1]]
            if block[0] not in (fill, separator) and len(set(block)) == 1:
                out[r][c] = block[0]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    from math import gcd

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    marks = [
        (r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
        if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != separator
    ]
    if not marks:
        return [[background]]

    def lattice_coords(values):
        lo, hi = min(values), max(values)
        step = 0
        for a, b in zip(sorted(set(values)), sorted(set(values))[1:]):
            step = gcd(step, b - a)
        if step == 0:
            step = 1
        return list(range(lo, hi + 1, step))

    rows = lattice_coords([r for r, c in marks])
    cols = lattice_coords([c for r, c in marks])

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] not in (background, separator)
                       and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners)
                       else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out or [[background]]
